description: Declaration-only behavior that declares a serial peer whose tx role is 'rts_n'. The pinned OpenTitan UART's uart.pins endpoint declares rx/tx/tx_en only, so the executor refuses the missing role by name instead of binding another port.
notes: the peer's rx_role is the UART's real 'rx' input; tx_role 'rts_n' is a role the ZipCPU UART declares and this one does not
the refusal is unsupported-serial:role:rts_n, raised by pin_group_declaration after the declaration normalizes
